sentences.text: 4. It was submitted that petitioner is ready to marry the informant and both the parties have settled their dispute.
5. Learned counsel on behalf of the informant has submitted that parties have settled their dispute.
6. In view of the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Ms.
